title: Renewal of a Residential Natural Gas Supply Agreement Within Its Term
content:
## Renewal in term

A customer renews an agreement still in its term by accepting the renewal offer on or before the contract end date: the agreement takes the plan named in the notice whose rate is the renewal starting rate and that plan's term in months, at the renewal acceptance rate set by this policy.

The renewed term starts on the day after the current contract end date and ends on the day before the same calendar day the renewed plan's term in months after that start, using the last day of the month when that calendar day does not exist.

A renewal is accepted only on an active agreement, and its own renewal loyalty credit arrives with the first bill of the renewed term.

## When the renewal acceptance rate is fixed

The renewal acceptance rate is fixed only after the energy line of the most recent bill, when it was billed above the rate the plan allows for its cycle, carries its rebill credit.

The renewal acceptance rate is not fixed until the agreement carries the sign-up credit that its completed billing cycles earned under its plan.

The renewal acceptance rate is not worked out before every renewal that has taken effect on the agreement carries its renewal loyalty credit.

### Renewed term dates (hypothetical contract end dates)

| Current contract end date | Renewed plan's term | Renewed term starts | Renewed term ends |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30 September 2025 | 12 months | 1 October 2025 | 30 September 2026 |
| 14 March 2025 | 24 months | 15 March 2025 | 14 March 2027 |
| 28 February 2024 | 12 months | 29 February 2024 | 27 February 2025 (29 February 2025 does not exist, so 28 February 2025 is used) |

## Recording the renewal

**Capability.** `accept_gas_renewal_offer_6e431548` records the customer's personal acceptance of the renewal offer on a residential gas agreement that is still in its current term, so that the agreement continues into a new term when the current one ends. One call rewrites the plan in force on the agreement: the plan name, the term length, the per-therm rate, the date the new term starts and the last day of the new term are replaced with the values given. The agreement stays active and keeps its number, and the customer can afterwards see the renewed plan, rate, start date and end date on the agreement record.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `accept_gas_renewal_offer_6e431548` and hands it over to the customer, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `gas_agreement_id` — the residential natural gas agreement number being renewed, as shown on the agreement record returned by the gas agreement lookup.
- `variant_name` — the official name of the plan renewed into, exactly one of:
  - `Beacon Ridge Gas Monthly Variable` — the month-to-month variable plan
  - `Beacon Ridge Gas Capped Variable 12` — the twelve-month capped variable plan
  - `Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 12` — the twelve-month fixed price plan
  - `Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 24` — the twenty-four-month fixed price plan
  - `Beacon Ridge Gas Price Lock 36` — the thirty-six-month fixed price plan
  - `Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 12` — the twelve-month carbon offset plan
  - `Beacon Ridge Carbon Offset Gas 24` — the twenty-four-month carbon offset plan
- `term_months` — the length of the new term in whole months (0 only for month-to-month service).
- `contract_rate_usd_therm` — the per-therm supply rate of the new term in US dollars per therm, a decimal carried to 4 decimal places; stored at that precision, rounded half to even at the fifth place if more places are given.
- `plan_change_date` — the first calendar day of the new term, written YYYY-MM-DD (local service date, no time of day).
- `contract_end_date` — the last calendar day of the new term, written YYYY-MM-DD (local service date, no time of day).

**Return.** A confirmation sentence naming the agreement number, the plan renewed into, the rate in US dollars per therm to 4 decimal places, the term in months and the new term's start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Receiving it means the renewal is recorded on the agreement.
